text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that both links to 54:49 and launches a fresh explanatory clause
words.prose: The opening particle makes 54:50 a bridge from creation by measure (54:49) into the command mechanism. Its force is not plain addition only: it coordinates the two claims, resumes the discourse, and lets the new restriction arrive as an explanation of how measured creation is executed. Because the connective is heard before the negation, continuity is established before the ayah narrows the command to one act.

topics.headline: boundary bridge from measured creation to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 54:50 does not start cold; it turns 54:49 into an explanation of measured creation through one divine command.
topics.reason: The word table marks a conjunction to 54:49, and the clause evidence licenses a complete nominal clause after it; the CRITICAL rows coherently preserve coordination, resumption, and boundary-bridge force.

words.gloss_range: negative particle initiating a negation-plus-exception restriction, not a relative or interrogative word
words.prose: The particle opens the exclusionary frame: every possible predicate for the divine command is denied until the exception supplies the only allowed one. That makes the first beat a standing definition rather than narration. The case-governance discussion is kept narrow: the following predicate remains nominative, so the payoff is not a laysa-like accusative construction but a restriction frame whose force is exclusivity.

topics.headline: negation opens exclusive restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first clears away every alternate description of the command before admitting only singularity.
topics.reason: QAC and translation support both mark the word as a negative particle in the mā...illā restriction; the CRITICAL rows correctly treat it as qaṣr, not ordinary negation.

topics.headline: governance debate limited by nominative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar preserves the predicate as nominative, so the construction is about restriction rather than a simple laysa-style case effect.
topics.reason: The Ḥijāzī versus Tamīmī issue has a valid grammatical core, but local QAC grammar identifies the following word as nominative predicate, so the topic is limited to case behavior inside the restriction frame.

words.gloss_range: the divine command or operative affair, possessed by the divine speaker and made the subject of an exclusive nominal predication
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans commanding, authority, and affair or matter; here local grammar keeps command and realized affair together under divine agency
words.prose: The possessed verbal noun is the ayah's subject, so the statement defines what the divine command is rather than narrating one event. The suffix makes the command God's own issuing act, and the root range keeps command and realized affair together: decree and execution are not split into instruction followed by process. Its sharp onset also gives the command word a marked entry after the softer opening particles. The later simile measures this already-defined command, while echoes of creative command (2:117; 36:82), the Hour formula (16:77), and Surah 54 command scenes (54:3; 54:12; 54:24; 54:46) show the local word gathering the surah's mechanism into one principle.

topics.headline: possessed maṣdar as timeless subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah identifies the divine command as a standing reality, with divine agency fused into the noun itself.
topics.reason: QAC marks a verbal noun as nominative subject with a divine possessive suffix; attachment evidence supports the suffix as possessive complement and the clause as nominal predication.

topics.headline: command and affair held together under executive authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not bare speech; it names executive command whose realization is already the affair it brings about.
topics.reason: Lexical rows validly preserve command and affair pressure, while local divine possession and restriction prevent drifting into consultation, deliberation, or a merely administrative chain.

topics.headline: surah and Quranic command echoes converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word gathers earlier command scenes and creative-command formulas into the ayah's universal statement.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly links the command frame to 54:3 and to the 54:12 command thread, while CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallels at 16:77, 2:117, 36:82, 54:24, and 54:46.

topics.headline: sharp onset marks the command word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small acoustic turn: the command word enters sharply after the softer opening particles.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and modest; it supports the word's marked entry without driving the interpretation.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the restriction and channeling predication onto the single following predicate
words.prose: The particle is the hinge where denial becomes affirmation. It does not add another item outside the command; it admits one predicate within the command's own domain and puts the semantic weight on singularity. Its compact sound sharpens that turn, and the construction belongs to a Quranic restriction pattern also used for absolute claims (53:4; 51:56).

topics.headline: exception turns denial into sole predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not merely say the command is one; it makes oneness the only admitted predicate.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as completing the mā...illā restriction, and attachment evidence identifies the following word as the restricted predicate.

topics.headline: Quranic restriction pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause uses a high-force restriction pattern familiar from absolute Quranic claims (53:4; 51:56).
topics.reason: The row gives concrete Quranic parallels, so the formulaic point survives as a candidate without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: compact recited pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the turn from negation to affirmation is also compressed in the particle's recited form.
topics.reason: The phonetic claim is local and supports the hinge effect without adding a separate grammatical function.

words.gloss_range: the single, exclusive predicate of the divine command, feminine and indefinite so the unit is exact but unnamed
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on oneness, unification, singularity, and theological unity; here it predicates indivisible unity of divine action rather than divine essence directly
words.prose: This word is where the restriction lands: the command is only one. Its nominative case keeps it as the predicate, while the feminine indefinite form points to an unnamed feminine unit, such as one word, cry, breath, or instance, without forcing one event type. The payoff is exact but open singularity: divine action is indivisible, while the numeral form keeps the claim on action rather than turning it into a direct essence statement. Its indefinite cadence also ties the single unit to the coming glance. Same-surah echoes with one-man and one-cry motifs (54:24; 54:31) and wider one-cry formulas (36:29; 36:49; 38:15) make the nounless form feel universal rather than vague.

topics.headline: singularity as restricted predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that oneness is not an added adjective; it is the whole restricted predicate assigned to the divine command.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as nominative predicate of the restricted nominal clause.

topics.headline: feminine indefinite leaves the unit unnamed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act is exactly one while the kind of unit remains open, allowing the statement to cover any divine act.
topics.reason: The feminine form does not simply agree with the masculine command noun; local grammar supports an omitted feminine unit, and indefiniteness keeps that unit unspecified.

topics.headline: oneness applied to divine action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that tawḥīd-like oneness is being applied to the structure of action, while the surface form remains a numeral predicate for the command.
topics.reason: Root-family pressure toward unity is meaningful, but the local noun-number form predicates one act rather than making a direct statement of divine essence.

topics.headline: one-X formulas become nounless and universal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that familiar one-cry formulas (36:29; 36:49; 38:15; 54:31) are widened here because the noun after one is omitted.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete references; the local feminine ellipsis supports the claim that a formulaic one-X pattern is present without selecting one named X.

topics.headline: indefinite cadence and breadth-to-unity movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from all things by measure (54:49) to one indivisible execution, with sound tying the single unit to the coming glance.
topics.reason: The boundary and cadence rows are coherent as secondary payoffs: they support the transition from exhaustive creation to singular execution without adding a new lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: simile preposition introducing the glance phrase as the sensory vehicle for the already restricted command
words.prose: The particle opens the second beat only after singularity has been asserted. It maps the command onto a concrete glance phrase, making the abstract claim perceptible without making divine action identical to human seeing. Its attachment can be heard as modifying either the command or its oneness, but in both cases the payoff is the same local bridge: the one command is made graspable through a marked comparison. Because the particle is fused to the glance-word, the comparison marker and speed image arrive as one compact recited unit.

topics.headline: explicit simile after the restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the simile explains the already-established singular command instead of weakening the restriction.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a preposition introducing simile, and attachment evidence treats the following glance as the governed simile complement.

topics.headline: simile can lean toward command or oneness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison can illuminate the command itself or the quality of its oneness, with no need to choose sharply.
topics.reason: The bundle licenses the compressed comparison after the predicate, so the ambiguity is useful but remains local to the simile's attachment.

topics.headline: analogy without reduction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse gives the nearest human perceptual measure while keeping divine action greater than the analogy.
topics.reason: The particle marks likeness, not identity; the claim survives as a boundary on over-literalizing the comparison.

topics.headline: comparison fused to glance-word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison marker and the speed image arrive as one compact recited unit.
topics.reason: The sound-form topic is local and supports the semantic compression of the simile.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite genitive verbal noun for the act of a quick glance, serving as the simile vehicle rather than an independent event
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes quick glancing, flash-like perception, and hinting; here the sight instrument selects the visual instant while retaining flash-like minimality
words.prose: The word names the act of glancing, not the eye and not an independent event. Its genitive case keeps it under the simile particle, while its indefiniteness lets any minimal glance instantiate the comparison. The root's flash and hint range is narrowed by the explicit sight instrument: the ayah selects quick visual perception, not indirect allusion. Because this rare formula recurs with the Hour's command (16:77), the glance is not casual imagery; it is a specialized Quranic measure for divine-scale instantaneity, and its phrase stays open until the final sight noun completes it.

topics.headline: generic act-process under simile governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison is to any minimal act of glancing, not to a particular eye or a separate event.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a genitive verbal noun governed by the simile particle; CRITICAL form rows correctly preserve indefiniteness and process force.

topics.headline: flash-like speed selected over hinting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concrete flash-speed of the image, while the following sight instrument keeps the root from becoming a mere hint or allusion.
topics.reason: The broader root family includes hinting and flash imagery, but local instrument grammar selects quick visual glancing as the operative sense.

topics.headline: rare glance-of-sight formula linked to 16:77
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the glance image belongs to a rare command-speed formula also used for the Hour (16:77).
topics.reason: The contextual evidence marks the form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows give the concrete 16:77 parallel in the same instantaneity field.

topics.headline: glance phrase pulls toward final sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the instantaneity image remains syntactically unfinished until sight closes the ayah.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the later sight noun as complement, so the phrase-level closure payoff is locally grounded.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition binding the sight faculty to the glance and excluding a causal reading here
words.prose: The preposition turns the glance into a glance by means of sight. That narrows the broad particle range: cause is not the local sense, while instrumentality is primary and attachment remains useful because the faculty is bound tightly to the act. The result is a nested simile, not just like a glance in the abstract but like a glance specified through sight. Its direct fusion with the final noun makes the instrument marker and sight faculty arrive as a compact closing unit.

topics.headline: sight selected as instrument, not cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the simile measures speed through the faculty that performs the glance, not through an unspecified flash or a causal phrase.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the following noun as governed by the preposition; broad bāʾ senses are narrowed locally to instrumentality with attachment pressure.

topics.headline: inner prepositional phrase completes the vehicle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two-layer architecture: comparison governs the glance, and the inner preposition specifies the faculty of that glance.
topics.reason: The nested structure is directly supported by the governed relation from simile particle to glance and from the inner preposition to sight.

topics.headline: instrument marker fused to final noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the instrument marker and sight noun arrive as a compact closing unit.
topics.reason: The surface-form and liaison rows support a secondary acoustic payoff without changing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: definite generic sight as the governed instrument that completes the glance simile and closes the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans bodily sight, visual perception, insight, and divine seeing; here physical sight is selected while perception-range thickens the simile
words.prose: The final noun makes the comparison land on sight as a faculty, not one person's eye. Its definiteness and singularity universalize the instrument, while its genitive government keeps it inside the inner prepositional phrase rather than as a second comparison. The broader perception field remains present but narrowed: physical sight is selected, and insight associations thicken the image without replacing the bodily faculty. As the endpoint, the word completes the rare glance-of-sight formula linked to 16:77 and turns the surah's earlier visual scene (54:7) into the final metric for divine command. Its heavier final sound makes the faculty-name the acoustic landing point after the lighter glance phrase.

topics.headline: definite singular sight as faculty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the simile invokes sight as such, not an individual eye or a particular observed glance.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as definite genitive noun governed by the preposition; CRITICAL form rows correctly read the article and singular noun as generic faculty.

topics.headline: final noun completes the nested simile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes only when the visual faculty supplies the missing instrument for the glance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the noun as complement of the preposition; structural rows validly read it as the closure point of the simile and ayah.

topics.headline: physical sight selected with insight range retained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen metric is sight specifically, while the root's perception and insight range keeps the comparison cognitively charged.
topics.reason: The local prepositional phrase selects physical sight as instrument; broader insight and divine-seeing associations are retained only as range-pressure, not as the selected sense.

topics.headline: formulaic and same-surah visual echoes close here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word completes the command-speed formula from 16:77 and reframes the surah's earlier sight scene (54:7).
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows give concrete references for the formulaic recurrence at 16:77 and the same-surah visual echo at 54:7.

topics.headline: heavy final sound lands the simile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final faculty-name is also the acoustic landing point after the lighter glance phrase.
topics.reason: The sound rows are secondary but local; they support the closure effect without changing the lexical sense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A command executes as one indivisible perceptual pulse.** `ء م ر` B002 is command/directive; `و ح د` B002 is numerical one and B006 making one; `ل م ح` B001 is a brief gleam and B002 a quick glance; `ب ص ر` B001 is seeing with the eye. The exclusivity construction reduces the command to one, then the simile gives that oneness sensory duration. I infer that no intermediate sequence is perceptible between directive and effect. The ayah reads divine execution as unitary and glance-fast.

2. **`أَمْرُنَا` may also be the whole affair under governance.** `ء م ر` B001 is matter/affair and B003 authority, distinct from B002 command. In the wake of universal measure, I infer that the entire governed process may be characterized as a single coordinated event, not only a spoken imperative. The command reading is sharper syntactically, but the affair reading preserves systemic unity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 54:55 ends with `مُّقْتَدِرٍ`, supplying the capacity that makes unitary execution possible. No later ayah further distinguishes command from affair, so both packet-supported scopes remain open.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`ء م ر / B002` (command or directive) with `و ح د / B002` (one single unit).** The measured creation of 54:49 means the command need not improvise or iterate; one directive can address an already proportioned order. The packet supplies measure -> one command; I infer complete prior arrangement -> unitary execution. **Reading change:** `أَمْرُنَا ... وَاحِدَة` describes coordination of plurality through one effective act.
2. **`ل م ح / B001` (brief gleam) with `B002` (quick glance), anchored to `ب ص ر / B001` (seeing with the eye).** Gleam and glance collapse emission and reception into one minimal perceptual interval. The packet supplies the visual comparison; I infer command -> reaches completion within the time of visual registration. **Reading change:** `كَلَمْحٍ بِٱلْبَصَرِ` gives efficacy a sensory timescale, not simply the adjective "fast."
3. **`ء م ر / B004` (growth and blessing), preserved as a distinct activation from `B002`.** The same focus window ends in gardens, river, and a settled seat (54:54-55), while it begins with fire and destroyed counterparts. The packet supplies one command and divergent terminal states; I infer unitary authority -> can execute generative as well as destructive outcomes. **Reading change:** `أَمْرُنَا` is not semantically confined to punishment by the preceding scene.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 54:54-55 supplied the principal surprise: the one command is not confined to destruction but also opens gardens, river, and a stable seat, confirming the distinct growth-and-blessing activation of أمر / B004.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Whole-surah - Hide Converted into Portable Water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An animal hide becomes a reliable water vessel through removal, joining, fine stitching, seasoning, and leak control.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The craft materializes the difference between possessing water and controlling access to it: portable provision depends on carefully maintained boundaries, whereas the flood opens boundaries and the final rivers flow without scarcity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A pelt is removed, matched, and finely stitched
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hide is skinned, retained as prepared leather, joined panel to panel, and closed with the small stitching used for a water bag.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: skinning and extracting a hide `quranic:root_001476:B003/m01`; prepared hide retaining its hair `quranic:root_000844:B006/m01`; joining two hide panels by stitching `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; fine stitching of a water bag `quranic:root_000865:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The vessel begins as an opened animal surface and becomes useful by exact reclosure. error_profile.preserves: Makam, yetki ve yönetici kişi alanını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetkiyi taşıyan kişi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yetki sahibi kişi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Makam ve göreve getirme anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi artma, çoğalma, bereket ve uğurlu çoğalış alanını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu büyüme çekirdeğini doğru taşır ve yönetim, buyruk veya belirti anlamlarına geçmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirti, yol izi, küçük yol taşı ve belirlenmiş zaman ya da randevu anlamlarını aynı dalda verir. Geçici çerçeve hem gösterge hem belirlenmiş vakit yönünü korur ve buyruk ya da yönetim anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

concept_map.definition: Kalbin veya zihnin bir şeyi bilip kavraması, doğruluğa ermesi ve bunun delil, ibret ya da açıklayıcı kanıt olarak görünmesi. Din veya belirli bir iş konusunda bilinçli hale gelme bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
Bu iç kavrayış delil, kanıt, ibret ve açıklayıcı bildirim anlamlarına uzanır.
Bir işte veya dinde bilinçli, kavrayış sahibi ve sağlam kanaatli olma özel bir kullanımdır.
Düşünüp tanıma ve kendini açık biçimde bilme bu bilgi alanına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak iddiası dalı bilgi, kalbin nüfuzu, doğrulanmış kavrayış ve delil alanında birleştirir. Aynı malzeme dinî sağlam görüş, ibret ve açıklayıcı kanıt kullanımlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlı gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم بالشيء ونفاذ القلب والمعرفة والتحقق والاستبصار في الدين والحجة والعبرة وشهادة الإنسان على نفسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد حاسة العين ولا اللمعان الحسي ولا الدم ولا السلاح ولا الحجارة ولا الخياطة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما العلم بالشيء وبصرت بالشيء إذا صرت به بصيرا عالما والبصيرة البرهان (maqayis)؛ البصر نفاذ في القلب والبصيرة اسم لما اعتقد في القلب من الدين وحقيق الأمر واستبصر في أمره ودينه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ حسن البصيرة إذا كان مستبصرا في دينه (jamhara)؛ البصر العلم وبصرت بالشيء علمته والتبصر التأمل والتعرف والبصيرة الحجة والاستبصار في الشيء (sihah)؛ لقوة القلب المدركة بصيرة وبصر وعلى معرفة وتحقق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yalnızca ışıklı oluşa indirmez; aydınlatan, açık kılan, kendisiyle görülen veya insanları görür hale getiren işlevleri birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dal kabul edilebilir, fakat tanım hem aydınlık hem de açıklayıcı işlevi birlikte taşımalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görmeyi veya anlamayı mümkün kılan açıklıkla sınırlıdır; göz organı ya da yalın iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin aydınlatıcı ve açıklayıcı işlevini verir; kalıba bağlı ayrı bir anlam genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin aydınlık, açık veya açıklayıcı olup görmeyi ya da anlamayı mümkün kılması. Bu alan, işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesiyle tanımlanır.

facets.statement: Aydınlatıcı veya açık kılıcı nitelik, görmeyi ve anlamayı mümkün kılar.
Bir işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesi bu çekirdeğin nedensel uzantısıdır.
Açıklama ve belirgin kılma eylemi aynı alan içinde kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda aydınlık, açıklık, kendisiyle görülme ve insanları görür hale getirme yönlerini bir araya getirir. Ayrıca açıklama ve belirgin kılma anlamı aynı toplu iddiada desteklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem ışıkla görünür kılmayı hem de açık seçik gösterme işlevini birlikte verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يوصف بأنه مبصر بمعنى مضيء أو بين أو مبصر به أو جاعل للناس بصراء، والتبصرة بمعنى التبيين.

branches.source_phrase_ar: المبصرة المضيئة تبصرهم أي تجعلهم بصراء والمبصرة بالفتح الحجة (sihah)؛ مبصرة مضيئة وتبين لهم ومبصرا بها (tahdhib)؛ آياتنا مبصرة أي مضيئة للأبصار وقيل صار أهله بصراء وتبصرة أي تبصيرا وتبيانا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kanın yerdeki yuvarlak parçası, bedendeki yolları, izi, küçük miktarı ve şiirde kan bedeli veya öç bağlamı olarak verir. Dalın kimliği kan lekesi veya kan izi alanıdır; iç kavrayış ve silah anlamları yalnızca eş adlı başka dallardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kan parçası, izi, lekesi ve buna bağlı şiirsel kan bedeli veya öç kullanımıdır; göz ve bilgi alanı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kan parçası ve izi anlamını verir; başka dallardaki eş adlı kullanımlar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yere veya bedene düşen kan parçası, kan lekesi ya da kan izi; bağlama göre bu izden hareketle kan bedeli veya öç konusu da anılır. Çekirdek, somut kan kalıntısı ve onun izleyici işaret oluşudur.

facets.statement: Yerde veya bedende görülen kan parçası, leke ya da iz çekirdektir.
Yerde yuvarlaklaşan veya parlayan küçük kan miktarı özel olarak belirtilir.
Kan izi, yaralanmayı veya atışı gösteren bir belirti olarak kullanılabilir.
Şiirsel kullanımlarda kan bedeli, kan davası veya öç anlamı bu kan alanına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak iddiası bu dalı somut kan izi ve kan parçası olarak kurar: yerdeki parça, bedendeki yol veya yarayı gösteren belirti. Aynı toplu iddia şiir bağlamında kan bedeli ve öç bağlantılarını da çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kalkan, zırh ve savaşta giyilen koruyucu donanım anlamında toplar. Bazı ifadelerde parlaklık veya şiir tanıklığı bulunsa da dalın çekirdeği koruyucu silah nesnesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kalınlık, yan veya kenar, dış deri, iki deri parçasını dikme, ev veya elbise parçaları arasındaki şerit ve iki parçayı birleştiren yama malzemesini birlikte verir. Çekirdek, kenar-kalınlık ile parçaların birleştirilmesi alanında düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesnenin kalın kenarı, yanı ve iki parça arasını dikme veya birleştirme alanıdır; taş, göz ve iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kalın kenar ve birleştirici dikiş alanını verir; başka kalıplardan ek anlam alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kalın dış yanı, kenarı veya yüzeyi ve iki deri, kumaş ya da kap parçasını bir araya getirip dikilen ara bölüm. Dal, kalın kenar fikri ile parçaları ek yerinden birleştirme fikrini aynı maddi yüzey alanında tutar.

facets.statement: Nesnenin kalın dış yanı, kenarı, yüzeyi veya yönü çekirdeğin bir bölümüdür.
İki deri, kumaş veya kap parçasının ek yerinden dikilip birleştirilmesi çekirdeğin diğer bölümüdür.
Çadır, elbise veya su kabı parçaları arasındaki şerit ya da bölüm bu birleştirme alanının özel nesnesidir.
İki parça arasında yamanmış veya eklenmiş şey aynı alanın sonuç nesnesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kalınlık, yan, kenar ve dış yüzey anlamlarını iki parça arasını dikme ve ek yeri nesnesiyle birlikte verir. Toplu iddia, çadır, elbise, deri ve su kabı gibi maddi örnekleri aynı kenar ve birleştirme alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem nesnenin kalın dış yanını hem de iki parçanın dikildiği ara bölümü korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kenar, kalınlık, dış yüzey ve birleştirici dikiş çekirdeğini korur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: بصر الشيء غلظه والبصر هو أن يضم أديم إلى أديم يخاطان والبصيرة ما بين شقتي البيت (maqayis)؛ البصر غلظ الشيء نحو بصر الجبل والسماء والحائط (ayn)؛ بصر كل شيء جلده الظاهر وثوب ذو بصر إذا كان غليظا وثيجا (jamhara)؛ البصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم والبصر بالضم الجانب والحرف من كل شيء وغلظها (sihah)؛ الباصر الملفق بين شقتين والبصيرة الشقة التي تكون على الخباء والبصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم (tahdhib)؛ البصر الناحية والبصيرة ما بين شقتي الثوب والمزادة وبصرت الثوب والأديم إذا خطت ذلك الموضع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yumuşak, parlak veya beyaza çalan taşlar ve bu taşlı yer adıyla açıklar; ayrıca bu yer adına gitme kalıbı verilir. Dalın çekirdeği taş türü ve taşlı yerdir, başka yer adları veya nispetler dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taş ve bu taşlı yer anlamıdır; göz, iç kavrayış, dikiş ve dış yer adları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak taş ve taşlı yer anlamını temel alır; o yere gitme kalıbı bağlı kullanım olarak ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar ve böyle taşları bulunan yer. Bu yer adından hareketle oraya gitme kullanımı çekirdeğe bağlı bir yönelme kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar çekirdektir.
Bu taşların bulunduğu arazi veya yer adı aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
Bu adla anılan yere varmak veya gitmek bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımdır.
Kaynaklar yumuşaklık, parlaklık, beyazlık ve alçımsı arazi niteliklerini aynı taş alanında toplar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda yumuşak taş, parlak taş, beyaza çalan taş ve böyle taşlı arazi niteliklerini birleştirir. Aynı toplu iddia, bu taşlı yer adından türeyen oraya gitme kullanımını da bağlı bir kullanım olarak verir.

Dallar eş adlı ve kısmen imgesel bağlantılar taşısa da her biri kendi madde, eylem veya kavrayış alanında sınırlandırılmalıdır.
